Package io.jengacode.eduvideo.production

Class FrameSequence

java.lang.Object
io.jengacode.eduvideo.production.FrameSequence
public final class FrameSequence extends Object
Shared single/multipart render input. A worker retains only the current chapter's renderer/backdrops.
